cross_cutting_issues.issue: MVP applicability is expressed generically as “according to pathway applicability” across rows. Preserve a per-profile enabled/required/optional condition so transfer, abandonment, referral, repeat loops, and policy elements do not become silently mandatory or acquire invented defaults.

Composite pathway records and duration records can describe the same elapsed interval. E0 should define which stage owns each active-work, turnaround, report/review, handover, disposition, transit, queue-wait, and boarding component to prevent omission or double counting.

The seconds-to-integer-ticks conversion boundary is acceptable for E0, but tick resolution, time origin, precision, and rounding remain an explicit joint E0/C0 decision; do not freeze those in this E0 recommendation.
